interpretation_note: Anza elevations are referenced to the hydrographic zero of the Port of Agadir; Ras El Ma elevations are referenced to the hydrographic zero of the Port of Ras Kebdana. These are separate local vertical references. The 2024 IHO report lists an Agadir ZH-to-NGM value of -2.159 m, but its applicability to the 2022 survey realization is unverified, so it is recorded only as a candidate tie and not applied. The report's Nador value must not be substituted for the Ras Kebdana zero. The title-block ΔZ geodetic translation is not a tie between the port zeros and was not applied to the survey elevations.
